# References

- [Richard Layton via RStudio, 2015. Happy collaboration with Rmd to docx](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/articles_docx.html)
- [Writage: a Markdown plugin for Word that converts Word to Markdown](https://www.writage.com/)
- [finalfit](https://github.com/ewenharrison/finalfit), a package for quickly creating elegant final results tables and plots, and [a tutorial](https://www.datasurg.net/2018/05/22/finalfit-knitr-and-r-markdown-for-quick-results/)
- [redoc via bookdown](https://bookdown.org/yihui/rmarkdown-cookbook/word-redoc.html)
